description: Main source file for USB mass storage sample in Zephyr RTOS, setting up USB device, filesystem, and storage.

methods.name: enable_usb_device_next
methods.description: Initializes and enables the USB device when using the 'next' USB device stack.

methods.name: setup_flash
methods.description: Configures flash storage, including opening and erasing flash areas.

methods.name: mount_app_fs
methods.description: Mounts the filesystem based on configuration (FAT or LittleFS).

methods.name: setup_disk
methods.description: Sets up storage disk, mounts filesystem, and reads directory contents.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that sets up disk and USB device, then enters USB mass storage mode.
